# ExiusCart

> ExiusCart is an all-in-one business management platform built for retailers, shops, and small businesses in the UAE, Sri Lanka, and the Middle East.

## What ExiusCart does

ExiusCart combines POS (point of sale), inventory management, order management, CRM, invoicing, VAT-compliant billing, staff management, barcode scanning, multi-branch support, and online store channels into one affordable platform.

## Who it's for

- Retail shops and boutiques
- Electronics stores
- Grocery and supermarkets
- Any small to medium business needing POS + inventory + orders in one place
- Businesses in UAE, Sri Lanka, and the Middle East

## Pricing

- Free Trial: 14 days, no credit card required
- Starter Plan: $12/month, billed in USD worldwide
- Premium Plan: $29/month, billed in USD worldwide
- No setup fees. Cancel anytime.

## Key features

- Point of Sale (POS) — works offline and online
- Inventory management with barcode scanning
- Order management (online + in-store)
- VAT-compliant invoicing for UAE businesses
- Multi-branch and multi-staff support
- Customer management (CRM)
- Sales reports and analytics
- WhatsApp and online store integrations
- Payroll and HR (Premium)
- Quotation and purchase management

## For developers

ExiusCart also powers custom storefronts — sellers can connect their own website
and call ExiusCart's public API directly for products, checkout, payment, and
customer accounts. All endpoints below require no login/API key unless marked
"auth: customer" (needs a customer JWT from the login endpoint) or
"auth: webhook" (called by the payment gateway itself, never by your storefront).

Base URL: https://api.exiuscart.com/api/v1
Every path below is relative to that base and takes {shop_slug} — the seller's
own store identifier, shown on their ExiusCart dashboard.

Categories
- GET  /public/store/{shop_slug}/categories — category tree

Products
- GET  /public/store/{shop_slug}/products — list; query: search, featured, trending, category
  Returns product_type: "physical" | "digital" | "affiliate". For "affiliate",
  render a button using affiliate_cta_text (fallback "Buy Now") linking to
  affiliate_url instead of Add to Cart — there is no checkout for this type,
  and the checkout endpoint below rejects it server-side if submitted anyway.
  Also returns faq (optional [{question, answer}] list, render below the
  description), shipping_note (optional free-text shipping/returns blurb,
  physical products only), shipping_steps (optional ordered string array —
  render as a connected arrow-flow, fall back to shipping_note when empty),
  seo_keywords (optional string array the seller is targeting — use it
  to build your own meta title/description and schema.org Product data, not
  a raw <meta name="keywords"> tag), and highlights (optional
  [{icon, label}] list of short facts to show under the price, e.g. "1 Year
  Access" / "Delivered by Email" — never present for affiliate products;
  icon is always one of: clock, calendar, mail, truck, package, shield,
  download, check-circle, refresh-cw, star, gift, tag) — all render only
  when non-empty.
- GET  /public/store/{shop_slug}/products/{slug} — single product detail
- GET  /public/store/{shop_slug}/products/{slug}/reviews — approved reviews for one product

Customer auth (auth: none — returns a token to use as "customer" auth below)
- POST /public/store/{shop_slug}/auth/signup — body: name, email, password
- POST /public/store/{shop_slug}/auth/login — body: email, password
  Send the returned token as "Authorization: Bearer <token>" on any endpoint
  marked "customer" or "optional" below.

Checkout & orders
- POST /public/store/{shop_slug}/checkout — auth: optional (guest or logged-in customer)
  body: items [{ product_id, quantity, variant_id? }], name, email, phone?,
  shipping_address?, use_wallet_amount? (logged-in only)
  Returns payment gateway request params (PayHere, Stripe, or PayPal — seller-configured)
- GET  /public/store/{shop_slug}/orders/{order_number}?email=... — guest order
  lookup + tracking. status moves pending -> confirmed automatically on
  payment; processing/shipped/delivered/cancelled are set by the seller.
  tracking_number/carrier/shipped_at are null until shipped.

Wallet (auth: customer)
- GET  /public/store/{shop_slug}/wallet — balance + last 50 transactions

Digital product delivery (auth: none — the download gate itself)
- GET  /public/download/{token} — reveals product/shop name only
- POST /public/download/{token}/verify — body: code — returns the real file_url

Blog
- GET  /public/store/{shop_slug}/blog — published posts; query: tag?
- GET  /public/store/{shop_slug}/blog/{slug} — single post, full content

Full reference with request/response field lists, error shapes, and payment-
gateway-specific fields: https://exiuscart.com/developers

## Alternatives comparison

ExiusCart is often compared to Zoho Inventory, Odoo, and Lightspeed but is significantly more affordable and designed specifically for small businesses in the UAE and Sri Lanka market, with local VAT compliance built in.
